purpose: Evaluate one preregistered deployment-profile expert map after V7 showed that switching experts within a run creates harmful state-path dependence.

expert_selection_rule.low: Hiku-P is first in both frozen E01-E03 mean throughput and QPR
expert_selection_rule.middle: Orion-P is first in both frozen E01-E03 mean throughput and QPR
expert_selection_rule.high: V6 structural NSESche is first in both E01-E03 mean throughput and QPR

diagnostic_basis.diagnosis: The same state can cross queue-density thresholds after earlier placement choices, so V7's within-run switching is endogenous and path dependent. V8 chooses one expert from the declared deployment workload profile before a run and never switches. Low and middle use the selected expert to seed the full feasible set, followed by the unchanged Nash best-response loop with the 15-unit paper-utility band. High exactly retains V6's restricted structural initialization because it already passed both rank gates. No weights, thresholds, or seeds are searched in V8.

candidate.reference_boundary: The expert and unrestricted initializer are excluded from the canonical offline reference key, start state, and objective.

eligibility: all nine reference builds and online runs pass protocol QC and result-blind pairing
for every load, geometric-mean throughput and QPR ratios versus first-version NSESche are each at least 0.98
overall geometric-mean latency and cost ratios versus first-version NSESche are each at most 1.10
for every load, mean throughput and mean QPR each rank first against the frozen E01-E03 baselines
screen.selection_rule: the sole candidate either passes every gate or V8 stops without opening confirmation

confirmation.closure_requirement: For every load, optimized NSESche must rank first in mean fixed-window throughput and mean QPR against the frozen E11-E20 baselines; otherwise report not closed without seed deletion.
confirmation.post_confirmation: Only after confirmation passes may the frozen optimized NSESche be rerun on E01-E10 for a descriptive 20-seed table; E11-E20 remains the independent confirmatory block.
